design.weekday_adjustment: six indicators with Monday as reference

temperature_basis.knots: factual temperature minimum, median, and maximum

lag_basis.knots: equally spaced from day 0 to the maximum lag
lag_basis.meaning: smooth basis over discrete physical lag days; design coefficient groups are basis components, not individual lag days

estimand.description: Sum over outcome dates of model expected deaths under the observed temperature history minus expected deaths under the same full daily temperature path shifted down by 1 C.
estimand.shared_outcome_window: 2015-01-22 through 2019-12-31; first 21 outcome dates removed for every lag and time-spline specification
estimand.interpretation: Conditional model contrast for this aggregate panel and the fixed path; not by itself a causal or climate-attribution estimate.

fit.algorithm: line-searched Fisher scoring / IRLS with weighted least-squares updates
fit.design_scaling: center each non-intercept column on factual design rows and scale to unit root-mean-square; apply same transforms to counterfactual design
fit.failed_replicates: count as uncovered in planned-replication coverage; also report converged-only coverage

covariance: daily score HAC with Bartlett kernel and bandwidth 14 days
daily score HAC with Bartlett kernel and bandwidth 28 days
inference.coverage_claim: No exact finite-sample coverage guarantee is claimed for the model or HAC intervals.

simulation.design: One fixed observed daily exposure, calendar, and counterfactual design; condition on the observed-data primary Poisson MLE for the model-compatible mean.

scenarios.name: model_compatible
scenarios.description: Independent Poisson outcomes generated from the fixed primary fitted means; use the same fitted coefficients and counterfactual map to calculate known truth.

scenarios.name: smooth_omitted_interaction
scenarios.description: Add a smooth seasonal temperature-response interaction to the log mean and calculate the known counterfactual truth under the same interaction.

scenarios.name: correlated_overdispersed_ar1
scenarios.description: Generate outcomes around the model-compatible marginal means with a stationary Gaussian AR(1) lognormal multiplier; the marginal means, and therefore the fixed counterfactual truth, are preserved.

omitted_interaction.scale: prespecified log-mean amplitude per 10 C seasonal temperature departure
omitted_interaction.status: declared data-generating scenario scale; not an empirically estimated temperature-error bound

correlated_overdispersed.latent_process: stationary Gaussian AR(1) on outcome dates
correlated_overdispersed.marginal_variance_parameter: sigma2 = max(log(1 + max(sum((y - mu)^2) - sum(mu), 0) / sum(mu^2)), 0), estimated once from the observed primary fit
correlated_overdispersed.mean_preservation: Y_t | Z_t ~ Poisson(mu_t * exp(Z_t - sigma2/2)); stationary Z_t has variance sigma2, so E[Y_t]=mu_t and A_true remains sum(mu - mu_cf)
correlated_overdispersed.status: prespecified dependence and overdispersion scenario using a data-estimated variance parameter; not a validated dependence bound

simulation.seed_rule: NumPy SeedSequence([base_seed, mode_id, scenario_seed_id, replicate_index]); pilot and formal streams are disjoint
